name.value: Tigh-Na-Mara Seaside Spa Resort & Conference Centre

description.value: Tigh-Na-Mara is a long-established seaside resort nestled among trees on Vancouver Island's central coast, offering accommodation ranging from pet-friendly rustic cottages to spa bungalows and oceanview rooms. The property includes the Grotto Spa and two on-site dining venues, making it a self-contained destination well suited to multi-night stays. Parksville's beaches and central island cycling routes are immediately accessible from the resort grounds.
